purpose: Prove a fresh agent can produce one valid skin recipe from docs/appearance-skin-contract.md alone.

agent.workingDirectory: one owned temporary directory containing only CONTRACT.md
agent.prompt: You are a fresh agent evaluating a design contract. The only file you may read is CONTRACT.md in this working directory; do not read any other file, repository, skill, or network resource. Read it, then produce one NEW valid skin recipe that Composer does not ship. Invent an id, name and one-sentence description. Reply with only the JSON object, no prose and no code fence.

isolation.whatHeld: The working directory contained only the contract. The prompt forbade other files, repositories, skills and the network, and no repository path was provided.
isolation.whatIsNotProven: The Codex CLI still loads its own host skills and configuration outside the working directory. No transcript-level isolation report was produced, so this is a fresh working context, not a hermetic sandbox.

checks: compiled to bounded CSS with no URL, import or animation

limits: The produced recipe was validated, not adopted into the shipped skin list.
No owner approval or design acceptance is implied.
One model, one run, no repeat count.
